description: Ultimate Cleaning Power: Highly concentrated gel formulation designed for professional-grade cleaning and restoration of exterior plastic and fiber components. Restores Original Appearance: Effectively removes dirt, grease, oils, dust, stains, hard water spots, scaling, and environmental damage to bring back the natural 'pre-damaged' look. Versatile Use: Perfect for cleaning car grills, Edges, Exterior Plastic Trims and hard to reach corners. Ideal for heavily soiled or neglected surfaces. Safe and Effective: Ensures no damage to car trims, hard tops, bumpers, and other exterior components while performing heavy-duty cleaning tasks. Easy Application: Effortlessly apply with an applicator brush—scrub and target the stubborn stain areas, using a water spray while scrubbing will enhance the cleaning effect. Finish by dry wiping with a clean microfiber towel, then wash and rinse with soap water to completely remove the product from the surface. Professional Product: Developed specifically for detailing professionals, making it a must-have solution for those aiming to restore the black plastic parts of vehicle exteriors. Powerful Stain Removal: Specifically formulated to tackle the toughest stains, including rust, hard water spots, and environmental buildup, ensuring thorough and effective cleaning
